newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to sell stakes in local electricity firms.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to sell stakes in local electricity firms.

text.p: Ukraine has given the go-ahead to sell stakes in 18 regional electricity firms but will retain majority stakes in each, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.

Mykola Sherbyna told Reuters the government would hold 51 percent in each enterprise, 30 percent would be made available to a strategic investor through tenders, and workers at each company would keep just under 20 percent.
He did not say when the sale would take place, but said the government order told the State Property Fund state privatisation agency to begin the process immediately.

The companies, located across the country, are Dniprenergo, Donbassenergo, Zakhidenergo, Tsentrenergo, Vinnytsiaoblenergo, Volynenergo, Dniproblenergo, Zhytomyrenergo, Zakarpatyoblenergo, Zaporozhoblenergo, Kievenergo, Kievoblenergo, Kirovohradoblenergo, Rivneoblenergo, Sevastopolhorenergo, Ternopiloblenergo, Cherkassyoblenergo, and Khmelnytskoblenergo.
